Class OperatorLPElementRenderPattern

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.client.gui.subgui.SubGuiBox
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.logicprogrammer.client.RenderPattern<OperatorLPElement, ContainerScreenLogicProgrammerBase, ContainerLogicProgrammerBase>
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.logicprogrammer.client.OperatorLPElementRenderPattern
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISubGui, ISubGuiBox, IRenderPatternValueTypeTooltip
public class OperatorLPElementRenderPattern extends RenderPattern<OperatorLPElement, ContainerScreenLogicProgrammerBase, ContainerLogicProgrammerBase> implements IRenderPatternValueTypeTooltip
Render pattern for operator elements, which edits the expression of the element in the slots and in the expression panel. The parts of the panel are in ExpressionParameterChips, ExpressionTextController, ExpressionBreadcrumb and ExpressionValueEditor.
